integrity: Complete analytical derivation and standalone symbolic and independent numerical diagnostics supplied. Scientific priority comparison is bounded by the cited literature and searches; no claim of independent verification or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two qubits; pair-conversion-only Hamiltonian; joint continuous-time Poisson reset to a diagonal separable state; independent local Pauli-Z dephasing. No claim for individual resets, arbitrary gates, amplitude damping, finite detuning, non-Poisson reset statistics or many-body dynamics. Product Gibbs temperature denotes reset preparation, not an interacting stationary equilibrium.
title: Exact reset-rate reciprocity and thermal entanglement boundary for a dephased qubit pair
